# Name of this part of the topic

This page covers <what part>, one part of <the topic, linked to its index>. It is for <who>. Read
[the index](index.md) for the other parts.

`order` puts the page in the index and in the site menu. The pages of a topic read in that order, and each stands on
its own: it opens by saying what it covers, and it links to another part instead of repeating it.

## First section

Write it as the template for its group says: `guide.md` for a task, `reference.md` for facts, `internals.md` for how
and why.
